definition: MindSpore is an open-source software framework for deep learning, machine learning and artificial intelligence developed by Huawei.
details: MindSpore is an open-source software framework for deep learning, machine learning and artificial intelligence developed by Huawei.

explainer.lead: MindSpore is Huawei's open-source framework for building and training AI models. It gives developers and researchers a full toolkit for deep learning and machine learning work.

tiers.eli5: It's a box of tools for teaching computers to learn, built and shared by Huawei so anyone can use it.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use it to build and train deep learning and machine learning models within one open-source stack. A common concern is ecosystem lock-in, since its tooling and hardware integrations come largely from one vendor.
tiers.paperLevel: There is no formal definition beyond describing it as an open-source software framework for deep learning, machine learning and artificial intelligence developed by Huawei; it is defined by its software role, not by a mathematical formulation.

explainer.example: A team building a deep learning model writes its training code in MindSpore rather than a rival framework, keeping the whole pipeline inside Huawei's open-source stack.
